'''Chief Surgeon''' was a title given to the senior [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] of the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jos Vondar]] was the Chief Surgeon of the [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
